title: a16z Podcast: Stories from the Frontlines of Synthetic Fraud

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Synthetic fraud—yes, it's a thing: a new evolution of consumer fraud that’s been emerging in financial services.
reader_summary.overview: Synthetic fraud—yes, it's a thing: a new evolution of consumer fraud that’s been emerging in financial services, to the tune of $1-$2B a year. In this episode of the a16z Podcast, Naftali Harris, co-founder and CEO of Sentilink, which builds technology to detect and stop synthetic fraud. Where did this new form of fraud come from, and why is it on the rise?
